items.text: Observation skills mean noticing what is actually there instead of what you expect, and they improve through short daily practice such as describing a scene in detail, noticing patterns in a process, asking what is missing and writing brief notes that you review later.
Practise short observation exercises daily, record specific notes and ask what you saw that surprised you.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
